name: Israeli whist
summary: Four-player trick-taking bidding game, an Israeli variant of Whist with trump auction and exact-bid scoring.
rules_text: Deal 52 cards, 13 each hidden. Dealer rotates clockwise. First bidding: left of dealer starts; players clockwise may pass or bid at least 5 tricks in a suit or NT. Must outbid highest bid by number or by suit rank NT>Spades>Hearts>Diamonds>Clubs. After three consecutive passes Highest bidder wins trump; if all four pass play Frisch: each passes 3 facedown cards left, only after passing own. Then rebid with minimum 6. Up to 3 Frisches, min rises each time, then redeal if still all pass. Second bidding: trump winner bids first, at least his first bid amount (0-13 allowed for others). Others bid clockwise any 0-13. Last bidder may not make total bids sum to 13. Then 13 tricks: lead player may lead any card, others must follow suit if able, else may discard or trump (cut). Highest card of led suit wins unless trumped, then highest trump wins; NT has no trumping. Winner leads next. Score: making non-zero contract = bid*bid+10, failing = -10 per trick off. Zero contract: make = 50 if under (sum<13) else 25; fail with 1 trick = -50, each extra trick +10.
